SEM_PAGAMENTO.O_QUE: The WhatsApp account has no payment method.
SEM_PAGAMENTO.FAZER: The account admin needs to add a card in WhatsApp Manager.

PASSOU_24_HORAS.O_QUE: The customer hasn't replied in over 24 hours, so WhatsApp only accepts a message template now.
PASSOU_24_HORAS.FAZER: Send an approved template; free chat returns when they reply.

NUMERO_NAO_RECEBE.O_QUE: This number can't receive WhatsApp messages.
NUMERO_NAO_RECEBE.FAZER: Check the number or reach the customer another way; they may need to update WhatsApp.

LIMITE_PROPAGANDA.O_QUE: WhatsApp held this promotional message because the customer already got many.

CLIENTE_RECUSOU_PROPAGANDA.O_QUE: The customer asked not to receive promotions from this business.
CLIENTE_RECUSOU_PROPAGANDA.FAZER: Don't retry; talk to them when they write.

TIPO_NAO_SUPORTADO.O_QUE: This message type can't be sent on WhatsApp.
TIPO_NAO_SUPORTADO.FAZER: Send it as text, photo or file.

ARQUIVO_RECUSADO.FAZER: Send it in another format, like PDF, JPG or MP4.

TESTE_DA_META.O_QUE: The customer's number is in a Meta test, so the promotion wasn't sent.
TESTE_DA_META.FAZER: Not your fault: wait for them to write or reach them another way.

CONTA_BLOQUEADA.FAZER: The account admin needs to check the notice in WhatsApp Manager.

LIMITE_SPAM.O_QUE: WhatsApp limited this number because many people blocked it or marked it as spam.
LIMITE_SPAM.FAZER: Send less for a while and check quality in WhatsApp Manager.

MUITAS_PARA_O_MESMO.O_QUE: Too many messages to the same customer in a short time.
MUITAS_PARA_O_MESMO.FAZER: Wait a few minutes and try again.

LIGACAO_VENCEU.FAZER: The account admin needs to reconnect it in Inboxes.

MODELO_CAMPOS_VAZIOS.FAZER: Fill them all and send again.

MODELO_NAO_EXISTE.O_QUE: This template doesn't exist in that language or isn't approved yet.
MODELO_NAO_EXISTE.FAZER: Pick an approved template and send again.

MODELO_TEXTO_GRANDE.O_QUE: The template text is too long.
MODELO_TEXTO_GRANDE.FAZER: Use shorter text in the fields.

MODELO_RECUSADO.O_QUE: Meta rejected the template for breaking one of its rules.
MODELO_RECUSADO.FAZER: Create another template with different text.

MODELO_FORMATO_ERRADO.O_QUE: A template field has the wrong format.
MODELO_FORMATO_ERRADO.FAZER: Check each field and send again.

MODELO_PAUSADO.O_QUE: This template was paused after complaints.
MODELO_PAUSADO.FAZER: Edit it and wait for approval.

MODELO_DESLIGADO.O_QUE: This template was permanently disabled after too many complaints.
MODELO_DESLIGADO.FAZER: Create a new one with different text.

DESCONHECIDO.FAZER: Try again; if it fails, send the detail below to support.
